events.desc: This June, Time Out Market Barcelona becomes the official home base for the Midnight Runners. More than just a run, this event is an experience that fuses sport with community. events.title: The World Cup at Time Out Market (for free!)
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Football is one of our passions — and it shows (with a regular line-up of live match screenings that’s impossible to ignore). And we couldn’t miss the chance to share all the excitement of the World Cup with you. Head over to Time Out Market to enjoy the matches for free on a giant screen, surrounded by fellow fans and with special food offers. Just show up for whichever match you want to watch. The tournament runs from June 11 to July 19.

events.title: Radio Time: Two Musical Events
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Time Out Market is turning into a stage for music and entertainment with experiences brought by Flaixbac and Flaix FM. On June 3, Marc Frigola and Andrea Romera, hosts of Bacstage, will spend time with Iván Herzog in a new edition of Intimate Flaixbac, an exclusive format that blends conversation and live music. Then, on June 12, Flaix FM will bring the rhythm with a DJ set designed to extend the afterwork vibe and welcome the summer.

events.title: Primavera Sound: Maria Hein + DJ Nahoomie
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: “God help me, ah! Lady Maria, thief of my heart!” If The Lady of Mallorca has also stolen your heart, then know that this June she’ll be stepping onto the stage at Time Out Market. The song title fits the performer herself like a glove: besides being a Mallorcan singer, Maria Hein almost seems to be portraying herself through this traditional island song (it’s hard not to notice the resemblance to the girl described in the single as having “long golden hair reaching down to her heels”). A breakthrough hit and one of the defining moments of her career, opening the door to a fusion of electronic music and folk.

events.title: TastOut: a tapas route
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Did you enjoy the tapas crawl on Wednesdays? Wednesdays still taste better than ever at Time Out Market Barcelona. From 7 PM to 10.30 PM, the market transforms into a culinary tasting tour with the TastOut, where every kitchen serves a special bite for just €3. Take note: if you collect at least 4 stamps on your "tapa passport", we’ll treat you to a free beer at the main bar.

events.title: Salsa Time
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: Do you love dancing salsa? Come to Time Out Market! Every Saturday, from 7 PM to 10 PM, we host a massive dance floor for you to move with other Latin music fans. Tickets are 10 euros and include a drink (water, beer, soft drink, or a glass of wine). And take note: we’re taking advantage of the good weather to hold the party on one of the coolest terraces in the Market (and in Barcelona): the Mestral.
